title: Poker Face
description: 《Poker Face》描寫一場充滿誘惑、慾望與心理博弈的愛情遊戲。歌中的主角將戀愛比喻為撲克牌賭局，透過魅力與挑逗吸引對方，卻刻意隱藏自己的真實感受，讓對方無法看穿她的心思。她享受曖昧帶來的刺激，也善於運用虛張聲勢與心理策略掌握主導權。歌曲中的「撲克臉」象徵情感上的偽裝與自我控制，同時暗示外在表現與內心慾望之間的差異。最終，《Poker Face》傳達的是愛情中的誘惑、神祕與掌控：當感情變成一場充滿試探的遊戲，表面的親密未必代表真心，而真正隱藏的情感與慾望，往往比展現出來的更加複雜。

vocabulary.meaning: 面無表情，讓人看不出自己的想法。
vocabulary.usage: 玩遊戲、收到驚喜，或想藏住情緒時可以用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Poker face」？
options: I poker face my birthday surprise.
She kept a poker face to showed her feelings.
He keep a poker face yesterday at the meeting.
I kept a poker face when my boss called me “Dad”.
vocabulary.explanation: keep a poker face 表示不流露情緒，這裡忍住被叫錯稱呼的反應。
optionExplanations: poker face 是名詞，不能單獨作動詞。
to showed 的形式錯誤；poker face 也強調不露聲色。
過去事件須用 kept。
keep a poker face 表示不流露情緒，這裡忍住被叫錯稱呼的反應。

vocabulary.usage: 想請朋友或家人留下來陪伴時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Stay with me」？
options: Please stay with me this math question.
Stay with me to waited for the train.
Please stay with me until the bus comes.
I stay with me at my cousin's wedding.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請對方陪自己等公車。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：不能用 stay with me 直接接題目；可以說 help me with this question。
to 後用 wait，不能接 waited。
正確：請對方陪自己等公車。
stay with me 是請別人留下陪自己，這裡 I 與 me 的安排不合理。

vocabulary.meaning: 開始非常喜歡某事，變得很著迷。
vocabulary.usage: 形容很喜歡一首歌、遊戲或活動時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Get hooked on」？
options: I got hooked on this song and played it all day.
I got hooked on to watch that new show.
She get hooked on the game last week.
We got hooked on very exciting about the festival.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：一直播放同一首歌，表示非常喜歡。
optionExplanations: 正確：一直播放同一首歌，表示非常喜歡。
on 後用 watching，不能用 to watch。
過去事件應用 got hooked on。
on 後需要名詞或動名詞，不能接 very exciting about。

vocabulary.meaning: 展現你有的能力或本事。
vocabulary.usage: 表演、比賽或展示自己的技能時可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Show what you have got」？
options: Come on stage and show us what you have got!
I showed what I have got to danced on stage.
Show what you have got the window is very blue.
She show what she has got yesterday at the art fair.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請對方上台展現自己的本事。
optionExplanations: 正確：請對方上台展現自己的本事。
to danced 的形式不成立。
錯誤：這樣接句子不合文法，也沒有表達展示能力。
過去事件須用 showed。

vocabulary.meaning: 和某人一起行動、一起玩。（口語）
vocabulary.usage: 跟朋友一起出去玩或參加活動時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Roll with someone」？
options: I roll with to my cousins after work.
I roll with my friends when we go to the park.
She rolls with her friends to watched the match.
We roll with our friends yesterday at the festival.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示和朋友一起行動。
optionExplanations: roll with 後直接接相處的對象，不加 to。
正確：表示和朋友一起行動。
to 後用 watch，不能接 watched。
過去事件須用 rolled。

vocabulary.usage: 形容少量的水、食物或一點點感受時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「A little」？
options: I have a little three brothers at home.
I need a little water after running.
She bought a little five big cars yesterday.
A little is driving the bus to school.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：water 不可數，a little 表示少量。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：three brothers 是明確的三個人，不能這樣搭配 a little。
正確：water 不可數，a little 表示少量。
錯誤：a little 不能直接修飾 five big cars。
錯誤：a little 不是能開公車的人。

vocabulary.usage: 比較兩個相似的人、東西或行為時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Just like」？
options: I just like to my cousin in this photo.
Just like is sleeping under my bed.
She looks just like to her grandmother.
My new haircut looks just like the mayor's. Help!
vocabulary.explanation: just like 表示十分相似。
optionExplanations: 表示像某人需要 look 等動詞；just like 後也不加 to。
錯誤：just like 不是人或動物，不能當主詞睡覺。
just like 後直接接 her grandmother，不加 to。
just like 表示十分相似。

vocabulary.meaning: 虛張聲勢；假裝自己很有把握。
vocabulary.usage: 玩牌或想讓別人以為自己很有信心時使用。
options: I bluffed my bike to school in ten minutes.
He bluffed about knowing the answer. He had no idea.
Please bluff the light because the room is dark.
She bluffed to knew the answer.
vocabulary.explanation: bluff 指假裝知道或有把握，以蒙混對方。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：騎腳踏車不能用 bluff 表達。
bluff 指假裝知道或有把握，以蒙混對方。
錯誤：開燈不能用 bluff；應說 turn on the light。
to knew 的形式錯誤；可說 bluffed about knowing the answer。

vocabulary.usage: 認真承諾會做某事，或強調自己說的是真的時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「I promise」？
options: I promise to called before the train leaves.
I promise my cousin to happy.
I promise I will call you after school.
I promised I will called after the meeting.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：保證放學後會打電話。
optionExplanations: promise to 後用 call，不能接 called。
to 後需要動詞，不能直接接 happy。
正確：保證放學後會打電話。
will 後用 call，不能接 called。

vocabulary.meaning: 從某人的表情看出他的想法或感受。
vocabulary.usage: 猜別人開心、難過或緊張時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Read someone’s face」？
options: I could read her face. She hated the new plan.
I read to her face and knew she was upset.
I read my friend’s face and found page twenty.
She read my face to knew I was worried.
vocabulary.explanation: read someone's face 指從表情看出心情。
optionExplanations: read someone's face 指從表情看出心情。
read someone's face 直接接 her face，不加 to。
錯誤：臉不是書，沒有第二十頁。
to 後用 know，不能接 knew。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: want to + 動詞原形（口語 wanna）
questions.meaning: 表達想做某件事；歌詞 wanna 是 want to 的口語拼寫。
questions.usage: 想說出自己的意願，而不是已完成的事。
questions.prompt: 新開的陶藝班很吸引人；哪句表示「我想參加」？
options: I want joining the pottery class.
I wanted pottery class to join.
I want to join the pottery class.
I want to joined the pottery class.
optionExplanations: want 後不能直接接 joining 表示此意。
詞序變成希望課程參加，對象錯誤。
want to 後接動詞原形 join，清楚表達願望。
to 後不用過去式 joined。
questions.explanation: want to 後接動詞原形 join，清楚表達願望。

questions.word: like + 子句（像某人那樣）
questions.meaning: 用 like 加子句比較做事方式；do 代替前文提過的動作。
questions.usage: 想學習別人的做法，不只是說兩物外貌相似。
questions.prompt: 兩位廚師用同樣方法切蔬菜；哪句最自然？
options: I cut them like my aunt does.
I cut them like my aunt do.
I cut them like my aunt doing.
I cut them like does my aunt.
optionExplanations: like 後是 my aunt does，表示像阿姨那樣做。
my aunt 是單數，需用 does。
缺少適當限定動詞。
一般此類比較子句不倒裝。
questions.explanation: like 後是 my aunt does，表示像阿姨那樣做。

questions.word: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 允許某人做事；let 後不用 to。
questions.usage: 要允許孩子自己試做安全的活動。
questions.prompt: 博物館老師允許大家摸模型，應怎麼說？
options: The guide let touch us the model.
The guide let us touch the model.
The guide let us to touch the model.
The guide let us touching the model.
optionExplanations: 受詞 us 應放在 touch 前。
let us touch 是受詞加原形動詞。
let 後不加 to。
此結構不接 touching。
questions.explanation: let us touch 是受詞加原形動詞。

questions.word: 命令句：動詞原形開頭
questions.meaning: 命令句可省略主詞 you，直接指示行動。
questions.usage: 給出清楚、直接且適當的操作指令。
questions.prompt: 導覽員請遊客打開地圖；哪句是完整命令句？
options: Open the map and look at the river.
To open the map and look at the river.
Opening the map and look at the river.
Opens the map and look at the river.
optionExplanations: 兩個原形動詞 Open、look 形成連續指令。
這是未完成的不定詞片語，不是完整命令。
動詞形式不平行且缺少主要命令動詞。
命令句不用第三人稱 opens。
questions.explanation: 兩個原形動詞 Open、look 形成連續指令。

questions.word: after + 現在完成式（先後關係）
questions.meaning: 表達某件事完成後，另一行動才發生；歌詞使用被動完成式。
questions.usage: 需強調完成某步驟以後的下一個動作。
questions.prompt: 先把海報貼好，然後開門；哪句正確？
options: After we have putted up the poster, we will open the door.
After we has put up the poster, we will open the door.
After we have putting up the poster, we will open the door.
After we have put up the poster, we will open the door.
optionExplanations: put 的過去分詞仍是 put。
we 應搭配 have。
have 後應接過去分詞，不是 putting。
after 子句用現在完成式描述先完成貼海報。
questions.explanation: after 子句用現在完成式描述先完成貼海報。

questions.word: 現在完成式被動：has been + 過去分詞
questions.meaning: 主詞是受到動作影響的人或物；此處 hooked 比喻被吸引。
questions.usage: 談某人或物已經受到某種影響而非主動做事。
questions.prompt: 一幅畫已被放進展廳，哪句是正確被動完成式？
options: The painting have been moved to the hall.
The painting has moved to the hall by the staff.
The painting has been moved to the hall.
The painting has been move to the hall.
optionExplanations: 單數 painting 用 has。
此句讓畫主動移動，與人搬畫不符。
has been moved 是現在完成式被動。
been 後應接過去分詞 moved。
questions.explanation: has been moved 是現在完成式被動。

questions.word: 關係子句：that + 動詞
questions.meaning: that 引導限制性關係子句，補充指明是哪一個。
questions.usage: 多個物品中要指出具有特定特徵的那個。
questions.prompt: 四把傘中要選紅色的那把；哪句正確？
options: Take the umbrella that are red.
Take the umbrella that is red.
Take the umbrella is that red.
optionExplanations: 單數 umbrella 要用 is。
that is red 修飾 umbrella。
關係子句詞序錯誤。
缺少 is。
questions.cue: the one that's on his heart
questions.explanation: that is red 修飾 umbrella。

questions.word: will + 動詞原形（未來意圖）
questions.meaning: 表達將來打算或預測的行動；I’ll = I will。
questions.usage: 即時做決定或說出未來要做的事。
questions.prompt: 明天志工會整理花園；哪句正確？
options: We will clean the garden tomorrow.
We will cleaned the garden tomorrow.
We will to clean the garden tomorrow.
We will cleaning the garden tomorrow.
optionExplanations: will 後接原形 clean。
will 後不能用過去式。
will 後不加 to。
will 後不能直接接 -ing。
questions.explanation: will 後接原形 clean。

questions.word: get + 受詞 + 形容詞（使……變得）
questions.meaning: 讓某人或物呈現某種狀態；原句具有成人調情含義。
questions.usage: 表達使東西變乾淨、溫暖等結果。
questions.prompt: 廚師要把湯弄熱；哪句語法和意思都正確？
options: The cook will get the soup to hot.
The cook will get hot the soup.
The cook will get the soup hot.
The cook will get the soup heat.
optionExplanations: 此處 get + 受詞 + 形容詞不加 to。
受詞應放在形容詞 hot 前。
get the soup hot 表示讓湯變熱。
heat 在此不是形容詞。
questions.explanation: get the soup hot 表示讓湯變熱。

questions.word: 雙受詞動詞：show + 人 + 內容
questions.meaning: show 可先接接收者，再接展示內容；後面可接 what 名詞子句。
questions.usage: 向某人展示作品、照片或結果。
questions.prompt: 畫家要給朋友看新畫；哪句最自然？
options: The artist showed her friend to the new picture.
The artist showed the new picture her friend.
The artist showed to her friend the new picture.
The artist showed her friend the new picture.
optionExplanations: to 使原本的展示內容搭配錯誤。
雙受詞次序錯誤，須用 showed her friend the picture。
show 雙受詞結構中不用此 to 位置。
showed + 人 + 東西，順序正確。
questions.explanation: showed + 人 + 東西，順序正確。

questions.word: what + 主詞 + 動詞：名詞子句
questions.meaning: what 子句本身可作為某動詞的受詞，語序是陳述句。
questions.usage: 要說明「我擁有／知道／需要的東西」。
questions.prompt: 有人問盒子裡有甚麼；哪句正確？
options: I will show you what did I find.
I will show you what I found.
I will show you what have I found.
I will show you what I finding.
optionExplanations: 間接子句不能用問句倒裝。
what I found 是完整名詞子句。
名詞子句不倒裝 have I。
缺少適當的動詞。
questions.explanation: what I found 是完整名詞子句。

questions.word: can’t + 原形動詞：無法做到
questions.meaning: 用 can’t 表示沒有能力做某事；後接動詞原形。
questions.usage: 遇到看不清、聽不見、無法完成的情況。
questions.prompt: 離太遠所以看不到字；哪句正確？
options: I cannot read the sign from here.
I cannot to read the sign from here.
I cannot reading the sign from here.
I cannot reads the sign from here.
optionExplanations: cannot 後接原形 read。
cannot 後不加 to。
情態動詞後不接 reading。
不能接第三人稱 reads。
questions.cue: he can't read my poker face
questions.explanation: cannot 後接原形 read。

questions.word: get + 人 + like nobody（非標準省略式）
questions.meaning: 這是口語／歌詞式的省略比較，表示「她對我的影響無人能比」；不是完整標準比較句。
questions.usage: 辨認歌詞省略；考題用完整標準英文表達相近比較意義。
questions.prompt: 在音樂會裡，沒人像那位歌手那樣讓觀眾激動；哪句完整自然？
options: No other singer makes the crowd feel like this.
No singer other makes the crowd feel like this.
No other singer making the crowd feel like this.
No other singer makes the crowd to feel like this.
optionExplanations: 用完整的比較意思取代原歌詞的省略。
No other singer 的語序不可顛倒。
缺少有限定動詞 makes。
make + 人 + 原形動詞，不加 to。
questions.explanation: 用完整的比較意思取代原歌詞的省略。

questions.word: a little + 不可數名詞／活動名詞
questions.meaning: a little 表示少量；歌詞 gamblin’ 是 gambling 的口語拼寫。
questions.usage: 想描述少量時間、運動或水。
questions.prompt: 跑步後想喝一點水；哪句正確？
options: I need a little three cups after the run.
I need a littles water after the run.
I need a little water after the run.
I need a little bottles after the run.
optionExplanations: a little 不直接接三杯這種數量。
little 此處不加 s。
water 不可數，用 a little。
複數 bottles 應用 a few。
questions.explanation: water 不可數，用 a little。

questions.word: when + 現在式（時間條件）
questions.meaning: when 引導時間子句，說明某個情況發生時的另一件事。
questions.usage: 談兩個經常同時出現的情況。
questions.prompt: 天氣冷時，這家咖啡店會關窗；哪句正確？
options: When it cold, the café closes the windows.
When it is cold, the café closes the windows.
When is it cold, the café closes the windows.
When it is cold, the café close the windows.
optionExplanations: 缺少 is。
when 子句用現在式表一般規律。
when 子句不使用問句倒裝。
單數 café 用 closes。
questions.explanation: when 子句用現在式表一般規律。

questions.word: not the same without + 名詞
questions.meaning: 表達缺少某個要素時，情況就不一樣；原歌詞提到危險的賭命比喻，非活動建議。
questions.usage: 表達某項活動缺少重要人物／元素的感覺。
questions.prompt: 樂團少了鼓手，聲音不一樣；哪句正確？
options: The band is not the same without to its drummer.
The band not the same without its drummer.
The band is not same without its drummer.
The band is not the same without its drummer.
optionExplanations: without 不接 to + 名詞。
句中缺少 be 動詞 is。
same 前面一般需要 the。
without 接名詞，說明缺少鼓手。
questions.cue: not the same without a gun

pattern.text: be not the same without + noun

questions.explanation: without 接名詞，說明缺少鼓手。

questions.word: if + 現在式，現在式結果（一般條件）
questions.meaning: 表達一般看法或規律；歌詞價值判斷屬角色觀點，不是普遍真理。
questions.usage: 談日常的規則、習慣或穩定結果。
questions.prompt: 這盞燈沒有電就不亮；哪句正確？
options: If the lamp has no power, it do not work.
If the lamp has no power, it not work.
If the lamp has no power, it does not work.
If the lamp have no power, it does not work.
optionExplanations: 單數 it 用 does not。
結果子句缺少 does。
if 現在式配現在式結果，描述一般情況。
單數 lamp 用 has。
questions.cue: if it's not rough, it isn't fun

pattern.text: if it is not rough, it is not fun

questions.explanation: if 現在式配現在式結果，描述一般情況。

questions.word: will not + 動詞原形（否定未來）
questions.meaning: won’t = will not，否定將來行動或意願。
questions.usage: 向別人保證不會透露消息。
questions.prompt: 朋友要求保密生日驚喜；哪句正確？
options: I will not to tell anyone about the gift.
I will not tell anyone about the gift.
I will not told anyone about the gift.
I will not telling anyone about the gift.
optionExplanations: will 後不加 to。
will not + tell 表達不會說出去。
will not 後應用原形 tell。
will 後不可直接接 telling。
questions.explanation: will not + tell 表達不會說出去。

questions.word: tell + 人 + that 子句
questions.meaning: tell 後接聽話者及所告知的完整內容。
questions.usage: 正式或清楚地告知他人一個事實。
questions.prompt: 職員要通知遊客博物館今天關門；哪句正確？
options: Please tell the visitors that is the museum closed.
Please tell to the visitors that the museum is closed.
Please tell that the museum is closed the visitors.
Please tell the visitors that the museum is closed.
optionExplanations: that 子句用陳述句語序。
此種雙受詞位置不加 to。
受話者不應放句尾。
tell + 人 + that 子句，結構正確。
questions.cue: tell you that I love you
questions.explanation: tell + 人 + that 子句，結構正確。

questions.word: be + -ing：現在進行式
questions.meaning: 形容正在進行的行動；bluffin’ 是 bluffing 的非正式拼寫。
questions.usage: 描述此刻正在進行的活動。
questions.prompt: 電話裡有人問妹妹正在做甚麼；哪句正確？
options: She painting a small boat now.
She is paint a small boat now.
She are painting a small boat now.
She is painting a small boat now.
optionExplanations: 缺少 is。
is 後需接 painting。
she 應搭配 is。
is painting 表示此刻正在畫。
questions.explanation: is painting 表示此刻正在畫。

questions.word: not A, just B（修正對方理解）
questions.meaning: 以 not A, just B 對比否定一種解讀並提出另一種；歌詞語義誇張且口語。
questions.usage: 要澄清事情的性質，排除甲並指出乙。
questions.prompt: 朋友以為你在生氣，其實只是累了；哪句正確？
options: I am not angry; I am just tire.
I am not angry; I am just tired.
I am no angry; I am just tired.
I not angry; I just tired.
optionExplanations: 此處應使用形容詞 tired。
not angry 和 just tired 形成清楚修正對比。
形容詞 angry 前用 not，不用 no。
兩個子句缺少 be 動詞。
questions.cue: I'm not lyin', I'm just stunnin'
questions.explanation: not angry 和 just tired 形成清楚修正對比。

questions.word: just like + 名詞（相似比較）
questions.meaning: 用 just like 比喻某人／物與另一對象相似。
questions.usage: 描述一件事非常像另一件事。
questions.prompt: 新建的塔像一支大鉛筆；哪句自然？
options: The new tower looks just likes a giant pencil.
The new tower look just like a giant pencil.
The new tower looks just like a giant pencil.
The new tower looks just like to a giant pencil.
optionExplanations: just like 中 like 不加 s。
單數 tower 需用 looks。
just like + 名詞表相似。
like 後不需要 to。
questions.cue: Just like a chick in the casino
questions.explanation: just like + 名詞表相似。

questions.word: before + 主詞 + 現在式（未來時間關係）
questions.meaning: 在表未來的時間子句中，before 後常用現在式，不用 will。
questions.usage: 說明先做哪一步，再發生另一件事。
questions.prompt: 離開劇院前請先檢查座位；哪句正確？
options: Check your seat before you leave the theatre.
Check your seat before leave you the theatre.
Check your seat before you leaving the theatre.
Check your seat before you will leave the theatre.
optionExplanations: before + you leave，用現在式表示未來時間。
before 子句詞序錯誤。
缺少有限定動詞 leave。
這種時間子句通常不用 will。
questions.explanation: before + you leave，用現在式表示未來時間。

questions.word: promise + 受詞（承諾某件事）
questions.meaning: promise 可直接接承諾的事情；歌詞重複 this 加強語氣。
questions.usage: 明確表示會履行一個承諾。
questions.prompt: 有人承諾會準時送還借來的畫具；哪句正確？
options: I promise to this: I will return the brushes on Friday.
I promise this I return the brushes Friday.
I promise this: I will return the brushes on Friday.
I promises this: I will return the brushes on Friday.
optionExplanations: promise this 不在 this 前加 to。
需要恰當標點或連接，時間也少 on。
promise this 後用完整內容說明承諾。
主詞 I 用 promise，不用 promises。
questions.explanation: promise this 後用完整內容說明承諾。

questions.word: because（口語 ’cause）+ 子句
questions.meaning: 因為後接完整原因子句；’cause 為非正式簡寫。
questions.usage: 說明為甚麼採取某行動。
questions.prompt: 導遊帶傘是因為可能下雨；哪句正確？
options: I brought an umbrella because was dark the sky.
I brought an umbrella because the sky was dark.
I brought an umbrella because the sky dark.
I brought an umbrella because of the sky was dark.
optionExplanations: 原因子句詞序錯誤。
because 後有完整主詞和動詞。
子句缺少 was。
because of 後應接名詞，不能直接接完整子句。
questions.explanation: because 後有完整主詞和動詞。

questions.word: 不定詞表示目的：to + 動詞
questions.meaning: to-infinitive 可用來表示做某事的目的；歌詞片語為短目的補語。
questions.usage: 說明為甚麼做某件事。
questions.prompt: 攝影師到公園拍鳥；哪句正確？
options: She went to the park to take photos of birds.
She went to the park take to photos of birds.
She went to the park to taking photos of birds.
She went to the park for take photos of birds.
optionExplanations: to take photos 表達目的。
不定詞語序錯誤。
to 表目的接原形 take。
for 後不能直接接原形 take。
questions.explanation: to take photos 表達目的。

questions.word: 形容詞放在 be 後作表語
questions.meaning: 形容詞作主詞補語，描述人或物的特徵，不當名詞或動詞。
questions.usage: 說明事物目前的品質或狀況。
questions.prompt: 舞台燈光非常明亮；哪句正確？
optionExplanations: 一般陳述句的 be 與形容詞順序不對。
此處需形容詞 bright，非副詞 brightly。
複數 lights 用 are。
are 後用形容詞 bright 描述燈光。
questions.explanation: are 後用形容詞 bright 描述燈光。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: fold
questions.meaning: 棄牌；摺疊
questions.usage: 玩牌時放棄這一局；也可指摺起紙張。
options: She folded her cards when she knew she could not win.
The player folded her chair to win the card game.
He folded the team because the score was too low.
I folded the answer because I did not understand it.
optionExplanations: 正確：fold one’s cards 表示在牌局中棄牌。
錯誤：摺椅可以說 fold a chair，但不能用來表示放棄手牌。
錯誤：不能用 fold the team 表示球隊輸球或退出。
錯誤：答案不能用 fold 表示「放棄回答」。
questions.explanation: 正確：fold one’s cards 表示在牌局中棄牌。

questions.word: raise
questions.meaning: 提高；增加（賭注或價格）
questions.usage: 可指提高價格、薪水；牌局中也表示加注。
options: The shop raised its prices when it painted the walls blue.
The shop raised its prices after the cost of food went up.
The shop raised its prices by moving next to the bank.
The shop raised its prices by closing two hours earlier.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：牆壁變藍本身不能說明價格提高。
正確：成本上漲後提高售價，raise prices 搭配自然。
錯誤：搬到銀行旁不表示售價增加。
錯誤：縮短營業時間不等於提高價格。
questions.explanation: 正確：成本上漲後提高售價，raise prices 搭配自然。

questions.word: intuition
questions.meaning: 直覺
questions.usage: 沒有完整證據時，憑經驗或內在感覺作出判斷。
options: Her intuition told her something was wrong, though she had no proof.
Her intuition was the bus schedule posted outside.
Her intuition was a list of names printed on paper.
Her intuition was a message she read on her phone.
optionExplanations: 正確：沒有證據卻感到不對勁，符合 intuition 的意思。
錯誤：公車時刻表是可查證的資訊。
錯誤：寫在紙上的名單是資料，不是直覺。
錯誤：手機訊息是外部證據，不是直覺。
questions.explanation: 正確：沒有證據卻感到不對勁，符合 intuition 的意思。

questions.word: spades
questions.meaning: 黑桃（撲克牌花色）
questions.usage: 描述撲克牌的黑桃花色，注意複數形式。
options: He bought three spades of tea for the picnic.
She had two spades in her hand during the card game.
The teacher used spades to measure the classroom temperature.
There were spades in the garden, so we played cards.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：茶不以 spades 作計量單位。
正確：在牌局中，spades 是黑桃牌。
錯誤：黑桃牌不能測量溫度。
錯誤：花園裡的 spades 是鏟子，並非牌局的黑桃。
questions.explanation: 正確：在牌局中，spades 是黑桃牌。

questions.word: pair
questions.meaning: 一對；兩個成組的事物
questions.usage: 形容兩個相配的人或物；牌局中也指同點數的兩張牌。
options: The two singers made a great pair of tickets.
The two singers made a great pair on stage.
The two singers made a great pair of noise.
The two singers made a great pair of music.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：a pair of tickets 指兩張票，不是兩個歌手的搭配。
正確：兩位歌手搭檔默契好，可稱 a great pair。
錯誤：noise 是不可數名詞，不可這樣說 pair of noise。
錯誤：music 也不能用 pair of 表示兩個人合作。
questions.explanation: 正確：兩位歌手搭檔默契好，可稱 a great pair。

questions.word: rough
questions.meaning: 粗糙的；艱難的；激烈的
questions.usage: 形容不平滑表面或艱難的經歷；語境決定意思。
options: The road was rough because the station opened early.
The road was rough because every sign was green.
The road was rough, so the bike ride was uncomfortable.
The road was rough because the map was new.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：車站提早營業不代表道路粗糙。
錯誤：路牌綠色不代表路面崎嶇。
正確：路不平，騎車不舒服，符合 rough 的意思。
錯誤：地圖新舊不代表路面不平。
questions.explanation: 正確：路不平，騎車不舒服，符合 rough 的意思。

questions.word: casino
questions.meaning: 賭場
questions.usage: 指提供賭博遊戲的場所；屬較具特定文化情境的名詞。
options: The casino had card games and many bright lights.
The casino sold train tickets to people at the station.
The casino was where the planes waited to leave.
He went to a casino to borrow a history book.
optionExplanations: 正確：賭場內有紙牌遊戲與燈光的描述合理。
錯誤：售票站不是賭場。
錯誤：飛機候機及停放區不是 casino。
錯誤：借歷史書一般是在圖書館。
questions.explanation: 正確：賭場內有紙牌遊戲與燈光的描述合理。

questions.word: pay out
questions.meaning: 支付款項；給付獎金或賠償
questions.usage: 常用於保險、獎金或其他款項的給付。
options: The company paid out because its new logo was blue.
The company paid out the meeting to another day.
The company paid out a song for its new workers.
The company paid out compensation after the accident.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：商標顏色本身不是支付款項的理由。
錯誤：會議延期應用 postponed，不是 paid out。
錯誤：歌曲不能當作 pay out 的付款對象。
正確：pay out compensation 表示支付賠償。
questions.explanation: 正確：pay out compensation 表示支付賠償。

questions.word: marvelous
questions.meaning: 極好的；令人讚嘆的
questions.usage: 讚賞表演、成果或經驗，英式亦寫 marvellous。
options: The play was marvelous because it ended at seven.
The play was marvelous because tickets were printed.
The play was marvelous; the actors were truly excellent.
The play was marvelous because the seats were numbered.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：七點結束不足以說明表演精彩。
錯誤：有印門票是一般安排，不代表精彩。
正確：演員非常出色，稱演出 marvelous 很自然。
錯誤：座位有編號不足以說明演出精彩。
questions.explanation: 正確：演員非常出色，稱演出 marvelous 很自然。

questions.word: stunnin’ / stunning
questions.meaning: 令人驚艷的；極出色的
questions.usage: 形容美景、外表或表演令人讚嘆；歌詞 stunnin’ 為口語省音。
options: The view from the hill was stunning because it had a name.
The view from the hill was stunning because the sign was small.
The view from the hill was stunning at five kilometers.
The view from the hill was stunning at sunset.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：景點有名字不是 stunning 的充分理由。
錯誤：牌子小與風景令人驚艷沒有直接關係。
錯誤：五公里是距離，不能單獨解釋令人讚嘆。
正確：夕陽時的山頂景色令人驚艷。
questions.explanation: 正確：夕陽時的山頂景色令人驚艷。
